speaker: Andy Bell of Ride
sentence: I’ve taken on board a lot from David Roback’s guitar playing. It’s kind of Doorsy.

speaker: Brian Eno
sentence: It doesn’t have to be this person at the front with all the articulation and every word clear. It can just be a person in that mess and that was a real liberation for me.
citation: Brian Eno, choosing Glider by My Bloody Valentine for The Quietus's Baker's Dozen: "One of the things that I really love in that is the fact that there's singing in there but you have no idea what it's doing... that was a real liberation for me." He says the experience of hearing it "has a lot to do with what I'm doing now".

speaker: Brian Eno
sentence: When I heard this record I really thought that I’ve got to change what I’m doing. But the change was actually to do with recording practices as much as anything else.
citation: Brian Eno, choosing Court And Spark by Joni Mitchell for The Quietus's Baker's Dozen: "When I heard this record I really thought that I've got to change what I'm doing," the change being in recording practice, while making Another Green World.

speaker: wire
sentence: At the time being a Nick Drake fan was a very lonely life, but I was always into him.
citation: Colin Newman of Wire, in NME's Soundtrack Of My Life (2015), on buying an Island sampler with Nick Drake on it as his first album: "At the time being a Nick Drake fan was a very lonely life, but I was always into him."
note: Thin: a youthful fan, no link to Wire's own music stated.

speaker: Cameron Picton of black midi
sentence: When I was younger, I had a neighbor who taught me guitar. He showed me all this Bert Jansch stuff, like "Black Waterside" and all that. I got really into it.
citation: Cameron Picton of black midi, to Stereogum (2021), on what went into Cavalcade: "He showed me all this Bert Jansch stuff, like 'Black Waterside' and all that. I got really into it." He says he went back to Jansch and John Renbourn while arranging in lockdown.

speaker: Stereogum (reported), on Suryakant Sawhney
sentence: He cites the Velvet Underground and Neutral Milk Hotel as formative, not only for their sound, but for being emblematic of a distinctly American do-it-yourself ideal.
citation: Stereogum (April 2023) reports that Suryakant Sawhney of Peter Cat Recording Co. "cites the Velvet Underground and Neutral Milk Hotel as formative, not only for their sound, but for being emblematic of a distinctly American do-it-yourself ideal."
note: Reported tier (writer's paraphrase). Second source: Rolling Stone India (2011) says Sawhney names the Velvet Underground "on lyrical inspirations". Peter Cat is not on the map yet (additions pass); owner spotted it.

speaker: Rolling Stone India (reported), on Suryakant Sawhney
sentence: Neutral Milk Hotel is a common favourite and one of the outfit’s major influences.
citation: Rolling Stone India (April 2011) on Peter Cat Recording Co.: "Neutral Milk Hotel is a common favourite and one of the outfit's major influences."
note: Reported tier. Stereogum (2023) also says Sawhney cites Neutral Milk Hotel as formative. Peter Cat is not on the map yet.
